**Classic Baked Lasagna – A Hearty Family Favorite**

> *Serves:* 8–10  
> *Prep time:* 20 min  
> *Cook time:* 45 min  
> *Total time:* 65 min  

---

### Ingredients

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|---------|
| **Meat & Sauce** | Ground beef (or half‑beef/half‐pork blend) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Italian sausage (crumbled, optional) | ¼ lb (110 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | ½ cup (75 g) |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2 tbsp (≈12 g) |
| | Crushed tomatoes (canned) | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp (30 g) |
| | Water / Beef broth | ¾ cup (180 ml) |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp (5 g) |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp (5 g) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp (2.5 g) |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp (1.25 g) |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| **Cheese Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (for ricotta mixture) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ⅓ cup (35 g) |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp (≈10 g) |
| | Pinch salt | ¼ tsp (1.25 g) |
| **Lasagna Sheets** | Dry lasagna noodles (no‑boil preferred) | 9 sheets |
| **Top Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Extra grated Parmesan | ¼ cup (30 g) |

*(Feel free to swap out ground pork for turkey, add spinach or mushrooms into the meat sauce, or use gluten‑free pasta.)*

---

### Equipment Needed

* Large skillet or sauté pan  
* Medium saucepan (for sauce)  
* Mixing bowl  
* Baking dish (9×13″ or similar)  
* Aluminum foil  
* Oven mitts

---

### Instructions

#### 1️⃣ Prepare the Meat Sauce  
1. Heat a splash of olive oil over medium heat in your skillet. Add onion and garlic; cook until translucent (~3 min).  
2. Increase heat to high, crumble in the ground beef (and sausage, if using). Cook until browned, breaking up clumps—about 7–8 minutes. Drain excess fat if desired.  
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water/broth, oregano, basil, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, cover partially, and let thicken while you prep other layers (~15–20 min).

#### 2️⃣ Mix the Ricotta Filling  
In a mixing bowl combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, and a pinch of salt. Whisk until smooth. Set aside.

#### 3️⃣ Assemble the Layers  
1. Preheat oven to **375°F (190°C)**. Lightly grease your baking dish.  
2. Spread ~½ cup of meat sauce across the bottom.  
3. Lay down three cooked lasagna sheets (if no‑boil, lay them straight; if regular, boil briefly per package instructions then drain).  
4. Spoon about one third of the ricotta mix evenly over the noodles.  
5. Sprinkle roughly ⅔ cup shredded mozzarella.  
6. Repeat layering two more times: sauce → noodles → ricotta → mozzarella. Finish with a top layer of sauce, remaining mozzarella, and extra Parmesan.

#### 4️⃣ Bake  
Cover tightly with aluminum foil (to prevent sticking, press foil away from cheese surface). Place in preheated oven:

* **Foiled:** 40 minutes  
* Remove foil, bake an additional 10–15 minutes until bubbling and golden brown at edges.

#### 5️⃣ Rest & Serve  
Let the lasagna rest covered for **10 minutes** before slicing—it helps set the layers so slices hold together nicely. Cut into squares, serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh basil leaves or a drizzle of pesto.

---

### Tips & Variations

| Variation | How to Adapt |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Vegetarian** | Replace all meats with sautéed zucchini, bell peppers, mushrooms, and/or lentils. Use vegetable stock instead of broth. |
| **Low‑Carb** | Substitute thin sliced roasted vegetables (eggplant, zucchini) for noodles. |
| **Extra Creaminess** | Fold in a handful of cream cheese or mascarpone into the ricotta mixture. |
| **Spicy Kick** | Add diced jalapeños or a tablespoon of harissa during sauce preparation. |
| **Quick Version** | Skip boiling noodles entirely if using no‑boil pasta; simply spread sauce directly onto dry sheets. |

Enjoy this comforting classic! If you'd like me to calculate approximate calories per serving—or adjust portions for dietary needs—just let me know.
